description: One letter from Thomas W. Merlan of the New Mexico Historic Preservation Division to Maria Chabot, Nov. 8, 1983. A draft of the "National Register of Historic Places Inventory – Nomination Form", Oct. 1982, with MC's margin notes and a letter from Betsy Swanson to MC, Nov. 12, 1982. One page of a letter from MC to Swanson, Nov. 24, 1982 [The letter is incomplete and without enclosures mentioned in the letter.] A note by MC, Feb. 22, 1983 and a letter from Betsy Swanson to MC, Mar. 10, 1983 with a copy of Swanson's interview with MC in a memorandum, dated March 9, 1983. A letter from MC to Betsy Swanson, Mar. 13, 1983, citing corrections needed in the Nomination Form and the interview and additions for the bibliography.
title: National Register of Historic Places
